core: Intestinal epithelial barrier and antimicrobial defense
qualifier: intestinal epithelial development and stem cell homeostasis
name: Intestinal epithelial barrier development and antimicrobial defense
rationale: Members combine intestinal epithelial identity, development, stem cell homeostasis and microbiota modulation with defensin and anti-nematode defense; the epithelial development and maintenance terms are what the antimicrobial-only confusables lack.

qualifier: SHC1 and GRB2 adaptor branch
name: EGFR and ERBB2 signaling through SHC1 and GRB2 adaptors
rationale: All members concern EGFR/ERBB2 (and ERBB4) signaling, mostly via SHC1/GRB2 adaptor events, EGFR transactivation and regulation, whereas confusables cover ERBB3/ERBB4 heterodimers and PI3K, PLCG1 or GRB7 branches.

core: RNA polymerase II promoter clearance and elongation
qualifier: cellular, not HIV-specific
name: Cellular RNA polymerase II promoter clearance, pausing and elongation
rationale: Members cover Pol II pre-transcription events, promoter clearance, pausing and elongation complex formation on host genes, whereas confusables are HIV/Tat-specific elongation or initiation and promoter opening.

qualifier: B cell surface signatures rather than activation or differentiation
name: Lymphocyte surface identity signatures, predominantly B cell
rationale: Members are mostly B cell, naive B and plasma cell surface or identity modules with a few T cell and butyrophilin terms, whereas confusables emphasise B/T cell activation, development, BCR/TCR signaling and germinal centre differentiation.

qualifier: PLC-gamma1, STAT3 and retrograde branches
name: NGF-TRKA signaling via PLC-gamma1, STAT3 and retrograde transport
rationale: All members describe NGF activation of TRKA and its PLC-gamma1, STAT3 and retrograde signaling arms, distinguishing it from confusables covering FRS2/ARMS, ERK5, CREB, p75NTR or NTRK3 branches.

core: Intermembrane lipid transfer and phospholipid turnover
qualifier: non-vesicular transfer plus lysophospholipid hydrolysis
name: Non-vesicular lipid transfer and phospholipid turnover
rationale: Members combine lipid transfer between membranes (glycolipid, PI/PC, ceramide-1-phosphate) with lysophospholipid hydrolysis and PI/sphingomyelin synthesis, contrasting with vesicular trafficking, flippase and de novo phospholipid biosynthesis confusables.

qualifier: glycan chain assembly and processing enzymes
name: Congenital glycosylation disorders of N-glycan chain assembly
rationale: All members are CDGs caused by defective ALG/DPAGT1/RFT1/MPDU1 assembly of the lipid-linked oligosaccharide or MGAT2/B4GALT1 Golgi processing, whereas confusables are defects in mannose and dolichol-phosphate precursor supply.

qualifier: MHC class I and II induction
name: Interferon-gamma signaling and MHC class I/II induction
rationale: Members are IFN-gamma receptor signaling, its regulation and response, and IFN-gamma-driven MHC upregulation, distinguishing it from Th1 differentiation and type I/III interferon confusables.

qualifier: sphingoid base, ceramide and sphingomyelin backbone
name: Sphingoid base, ceramide and sphingomyelin synthesis and catabolism
rationale: Members cover de novo sphingoid/ceramide synthesis, sphingomyelin synthesis and sphingolipid catabolism, unlike confusables on fatty acid elongation, glycosphingolipids or regulatory ceramide signaling.

qualifier: both excitatory and inhibitory synapses
name: Postsynaptic receptor clustering at excitatory and inhibitory synapses
rationale: Members concern postsynaptic assembly via GABA-A/gephyrin and NMDA/PSD-95 clustering, neuroligin interactions and EPSP/IPSP regulation, whereas confusables emphasise presynaptic assembly and synaptic adhesion molecules.

qualifier: pituitary hormone secretion via ghrelin, somatostatin and glucagon-family receptors
name: Peptide hormone control of feeding and pituitary hormone secretion
rationale: Members combine eating-behaviour regulation with ghrelin, somatostatin, glucagon-type and relaxin receptor signaling and growth hormone/prolactin secretion, distinguishing it from calcitonin/amylin, leptin and nutrient-receptor confusables.

core: Neural control of locomotor and exploratory behaviour
qualifier: positive regulation of glutamatergic and GABAergic transmission
name: Glutamatergic and GABAergic transmission in locomotor and exploratory behaviour
rationale: Members pair exploratory, grooming and psychomotor behaviours and amygdala development with enhanced glutamatergic and GABAergic transmission, the latter lacking in most behavioural confusables.

qualifier: redox homeostasis and aldehyde detoxification
name: Glutathione-centred redox homeostasis and aldehyde detoxification
rationale: Members cover glutathione synthesis, recycling, transport and inherited defects together with ROS and methylglyoxal/aldehyde detoxification and NADPH regeneration, unlike ascorbate/NADP, ferroptosis, transsulfuration or alkylation-repair confusables.

qualifier: lipoxin and leukotriene B4 synthesis and omega-oxidative inactivation
name: Lipoxin and leukotriene B4 formation and omega-oxidative inactivation
rationale: Members cover 5-HETE, lipoxin and LTB4 metabolism and their omega-oxidation catabolism, whereas confusables cover 12/15-lipoxygenase products, resolvins or cysteinyl leukotrienes.

qualifier: BAF and CHD1/2 remodellers with lysine acetylation
name: BAF chromatin remodelling and protein lysine acetylation
rationale: Members are BAF complex variants and CHD1/2 remodellers alongside histone, N-terminal and tubulin acetylation, distinguishing it from methylation-, repressive chromatin- and nucleosome-assembly confusables.

qualifier: receptor internalization, pinocytosis and caveolar/raft entry
name: Regulation of receptor internalization and caveolar endocytic uptake
rationale: Members regulate receptor internalization, pinocytosis, raft/caveolin endocytosis and early endosome entry, whereas confusables focus on endocytic recycling or lysosomal receptor degradation.

qualifier: RB1 mutant defects and cyclin E-CDK2 phosphorylation
name: RB1-E2F G1/S checkpoint and its disruption by RB1 mutants
rationale: Members concern RB1 restraint of E2F at G1/S, its cyclin E-CDK2 phosphorylation and RB1 mutant defects, whereas confusables are E2F target transcription and G2/M modules.

qualifier: labyrinth, trophoblast giant cells and decidua
name: Placental labyrinth, trophoblast giant cell and decidual development
rationale: Members cover chorio-allantoic fusion, labyrinth branching and vasculature, trophoblast giant cell endoreduplication and decidualization, unlike early lineage, trophoblast migration or ovarian confusables.

qualifier: renin-angiotensin, renal and vasoconstrictor control
name: Renin-angiotensin, renal and vasoconstrictor control of arterial blood pressure
rationale: Members concern angiotensin production and signaling, renal sodium/volume and glomerular control, vasopressin/endothelin vasoconstriction and peptide catabolism, versus confusables on NO-cGMP smooth muscle relaxation or vasopressin water homeostasis.

qualifier: sodium-phosphate cotransport and its mineralization disorders
name: Vitamin D and phosphate homeostasis in bone and tooth mineralization
rationale: Members combine vitamin D activation/inactivation and its defects, FGF23-Klotho and PTH signaling, Na/Pi cotransporters and their disorders, and bone/enamel mineralization, unlike chondrocyte, vitamin K or odontogenesis confusables.

qualifier: lens, cornea, iris and optic cup rather than retinal neurons
name: Lens, cornea, iris and optic cup morphogenesis
rationale: Members cover lens fiber development and transparency, cornea, iris, eyelid, pigmentation and optic cup morphogenesis, whereas confusables cover photoreceptor/retinal neuron differentiation, optic nerve or hyaloid regression.

qualifier: cohesion, alignment and checkpoint in female meiosis
name: Oocyte meiotic chromosome cohesion, alignment and segregation
rationale: Members cover meiotic sister chromatid cohesion, chiasmata, spindle assembly, metaphase alignment, checkpoint and anaphase control in female meiosis, unlike recombination/synapsis or meiosis I entry confusables.

qualifier: regionalization and border specification
name: Neural plate formation, regionalization and border specification
rationale: Members cover anterior/posterior neural plate formation, border specification, neural fold formation and early axial patterning, whereas confusables cover axial mesoderm/notochord or neural crest and hindbrain patterning.

qualifier: perinuclear sequestration of misfolded proteins
name: Aggresome formation and aggrephagy of misfolded proteins
rationale: Members concern misfolded protein oligomerization, perinuclear aggresome assembly and its autophagic clearance, unlike chaperone-mediated autophagy, stress granule or ERAD confusables.

qualifier: pacemaker depolarization and gap-junction coupling
name: Cardiac pacemaker depolarization and electrical coupling in conduction system
rationale: Members cover SA/AV node and His-Purkinje depolarization, HCN channels and gap-junction electrical coupling, whereas confusables cover conduction system development or repolarization phases and potassium channels.
